description: Help agent that answers questions about TypeAgent - its commands and what it is.

schema.description: Answers questions about TypeAgent itself. Use for: finding the command or action for a task ('what's the command for X', 'how do I X', 'can I X in TypeAgent'); and explaining TypeAgent overall ('what is TypeAgent', 'what can it do', 'how do I set it up'). Do NOT use for general-knowledge questions, web lookups, describing a specific named agent (the built-in describe handles that), or actually performing the task in another domain such as playing music, sending email, editing code, or controlling a browser.
